ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal regions of both lobes consist of high-intensity white fields. The left distal lobe contains 3-4 distinct vertical low-intensity striations. The right distal lobe features a high-density mottled transition zone where low-intensity black pixel clusters intersperse with the white field. The central and basal fluke regions are uniform low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 18% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, multi-frequency serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits higher pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys (estimated 10-15 pixel variance) compared to the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong concave trajectory from the distal tips toward the median notch, while leading edges (outer margins) follow a smooth convex curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse clusters of roughly circular high-intensity white pixels (diameter 3-8 pixels) located in the lower-central black pigmented area of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned vertical dark linear marks crossing the high-intensity white distal surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch at the distal terminus of the right lobe trailing edge; dark, irregular pixel cluster protruding from the far left lobe tip.
